March 31, 1988) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Dijlah Al-Jamiea SC|Dijlah Al-Jamiea]] of the [[Iraqi Basketball Premier League]]. He played college basketball for [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]]. ==High school career== Liggins attended [[George Washington High School (Chicago)|George Washington High School]] in Chicago and transferred to [[Findlay Prep]] in [[Henderson, Nevada]], for his senior season.{{cite news |last1=Clark |first1=Mike |title=Liggins leaves Washington |url=https://www.newspapers.com/article/the-times-liggins-leaves-washington/160945228/ |access-date=December 15, 2024 |work=The Times |date=September 5, 2007 |page=97 |via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} Considered a four-star recruit by [[Rivals.com]], Liggins was listed as the No. 6 point guard and the No. 28 player in the nation in 2008.{{cite web|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/footballrecruiting/basketball/recruiting/player-DeAndre-Liggins-42631|title=DeAndre Liggins Recruiting Profile|work=Yahoo.com|access-date=September 6, 2013}} ==College career== Liggins played three years at the [[University of Kentucky]]. He spent his first two years mostly coming off the bench, but in his junior year, coach [[John Calipari]] decided to start him. After his junior season, he elected to enter the [[2011 NBA draft]]. ==Professional career== ===Orlando Magic (2011–2012)=== On June 24, 2011, Liggins was selected with the 53rd overall pick in the [[2011 NBA draft]] by the [[Orlando Magic]].{{cite web|first=Evan|last=Dunlap|url=http://www.orlandopinstripedpost.com/2011/6/24/2241076/orlando-magic-draft-deandre-liggins-kentucky-wildcats|title=Orlando Magic Select DeAndre Liggins with 53rd Overall Pick in 2011 NBA Draft|work=OrlandoPinstripedPost.com|publisher=SB Nation|date=June 24, 2011|access-date=January 29, 2016}} Liggins made his NBA debut for Orlando on February 20, 2012, in a road game against the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] where he recorded three points and two rebounds in 10 minutes on the court.{{cite web|first=Evan|last=Dunlap|url=http://www.orlandopinstripedpost.com/2012/2/20/2813137/deandre-liggins-orlando-magic-nba-debut-kentucky-basketball|title=DeAndre Liggins Makes NBA Debut for Orlando Magic|work=OrlandoPinstripedPost.com|publisher=SB Nation|date=February 20, 2012|access-date=November 25, 2013}} In July 2012, he joined the Magic for the 2012 NBA Summer League. ===Oklahoma City Thunder (2012–2013)=== On September 12, 2012, Liggins signed with the [[Oklahoma City Thunder]].{{cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=10916|title=OKC Thunder sign DeAndre Liggins and Andy Rautins|work=InsideHoops.com|date=September 12, 2012|access-date=September 12, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131202225948/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=10916|archive-date=December 2, 2013|url-status=dead}} During the 2012–13 season, he had multiple assignments with the [[Tulsa 66ers]] of the [[NBA Development League]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2012_13.html |title=2012-13 NBA Assignments |work=[[National Basketball Association]]|access-date=September 6, 2013 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140327190108/http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2012_13.html |archive-date=March 27, 2014 }} On January 13, 2013, Liggins started his first NBA game for the Thunder against the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in Portland. He recorded 11 points and nine rebounds as the Thunder defeated the Trail Blazers, 87–83. In July 2013, he joined the Thunder for the [[2013 NBA Summer League]]. On September 6, 2013, Liggins was waived by the Thunder.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/thunder/news/release_130906|title=Thunder Waives DeAndre Liggins|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=September 6, 2013|access-date=September 6, 2013}} ===Sioux Falls Skyforce and Miami Heat (2013–2014)=== In November 2013, Liggins was acquired by the [[Sioux Falls Skyforce]]. On February 3, 2014, he was named to the Futures All-Star roster for the 2014 [[NBA Development League All-Star Game|NBA D-League All-Star Game]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/nba_dleague_all_star_2014_02_03.html|title=Eighth Annual NBA D-League All-Star Game Features 16 Players With NBA Experience|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=February 3, 2014|access-date=February 3, 2014|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140207181043/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/nba_dleague_all_star_2014_02_03.html|archive-date=February 7, 2014}} On February 25, 2014, Liggins signed a 10-day contract with the [[Miami Heat]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-signs-deandre-liggins|title=HEAT Signs DeAndre Liggins|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=February 25, 2014|access-date=February 25, 2014}} On March 8, 2014, he signed a second 10-day contract with the Heat.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-signs-deandre-liggins-0|title=HEAT Signs DeAndre Liggins|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=March 8, 2014|access-date=March 8, 2014}} The next day, he was assigned to the Sioux Falls Skyforce.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/heat/news/deandre-liggins-join-skyforce|title=DeAndre Liggins to Join Skyforce|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=March 9, 2014|access-date=March 9, 2014}} He was recalled a day later. On March 14, 2014, he was waived by the Heat. He managed only one game for the Heat, recording 2 points and 1 rebound.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/heat/news/heat-signs-justin-hamilton|title=HEAT Signs Justin Hamilton|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=March 14, 2014|access-date=March 14, 2014}} On March 18, 2014, he was re-acquired by the Skyforce.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/siouxfalls/liggins_140318.html|title=DeAndre Liggins Returns to Skyforce|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=March 18, 2014|access-date=March 18, 2014}} On April 21, he was named the 2014 [[NBA Development League Defensive Player of the Year Award|D-League Defensive Player of the Year]].{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/deandre_liggins_nba_dleague_defensive_player_of_year_2014_04_21.html|title=DeAndre Liggins Named 2014 NBA D-League Defensive Player of the Year|access-date=April 22, 2014|date=April 21, 2014|publisher=NBA}} ===Russia and Germany (2014–2015)=== In July 2014, Liggins joined the [[Detroit Pistons]] for the Orlando Summer League and the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] for the Las Vegas Summer League. On October 15, 2014, he signed with [[BC Krasny Oktyabr|Krasny Oktyabr]] of Russia for the 2014–15 season.{{cite web|url=http://www.bcredoctober.com/news/603/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141018022117/http://www.bcredoctober.com/news/603|url-status=usurped|archive-date=October 18, 2014|title=ДеАндре Лиггинс подписал контракт с "Красным Октябрем"|work=BCRedOctober.com|date=October 15, 2014|access-date=October 15, 2014|language=ru}} On January 20, 2015, he parted ways with Krasny Oktyabr.{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/149332/krasny-oktyabr-parted-ways-with-liggins-signing-jamont-gordon.html|title=Krasny Oktyabr parted ways with Liggins, signing Jamont Gordon|work=Sportando.com|date=January 20, 2015|access-date=January 20, 2015}} On February 27, 2015, he signed with [[Eisbären Bremerhaven]] of Germany for the rest of the season.{{cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/germany/153766/eisbaren-bremerhaven-lands-deandre-liggins.html|title=Eisbaren-Bremerhaven lands DeAndre Liggins|work=Sportando.com|date=February 27, Liggins|work=ESPN.com|date=April 9, 2017|access-date=April 9, 2017}} ===Dallas Mavericks (2017)=== On April 11, 2017, Liggins was claimed off waivers by the [[Dallas Mavericks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.mavs.com/mavericks-awarded-deandre-liggins-on-waiver-claim/|title=Mavericks awarded DeAndre Liggins on waiver claim|work=Mavs.com|date=April 11, 2017|access-date=April 11, 2017}} ===2017 off-season=== On June 28, 2017, Liggins was traded to the [[Houston Rockets]] for cash considerations,{{cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=20455|title=Mavericks trade DeAndre Liggins to Rockets|work=InsideHoops.com|date=June 28, 2017|access-date=June 28, 2017}} then immediately traded to the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] as part of the trade that sent [[Chris Paul]] to Houston.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/clippers/press-release-la-clippers-acquire-seven-players-and-draft-pick-including-beverley-dekker-harrell-and|title=Press Release: L.A. Clippers Acquire Seven Players and Draft Pick, Including Beverley, Dekker, Harrell and Williams|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=June 28, 2017|access-date=June 28, 2017}} On September 25, he was again traded – this time to the [[Atlanta Hawks]] for draft considerations. He was waived by the Hawks within a few hours of the transaction.{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/hawks/news/hawks-acquire-cash-trade-clippers|title=Hawks Acquire Cash In Trade With Clippers|work=[[National Basketball Association]]|date=September 25, 2017|access-date=September 25, 2017}} On October 10, 2017, Liggins signed with the Miami Heat.{{cite
